title: Committee Invitation
intro: Join the movement that is transforming how Brazil combats misinformation. Be part of a collaborative network of educators, researchers, and institutions committed to democracy.

hero.title:
Truth is a right.
Fact-checking,
a tool.
hero.description: Join the movement that is transforming how Brazil combats misinformation. Be part of a collaborative network of educators, researchers, and institutions committed to democracy.
hero.quote: ”Misinformation is an existential threat to democracy. Fighting it requires unity, method, and collective commitment.”

mission.title: Building a society where the search for truth is valued
mission.description: AletheiaFact.org is a non-profit organization focused on combating misinformation and democratizing access to fact-checking. We believe that a well-informed society strengthens the pillars of democracy.

combat.title: Fighting Misinformation
combat.description: We develop methodologies and tools to identify and combat fake news in a collaborative and transparent way.

network.title: Collaborative Network
network.description: We connect educators, researchers, and institutions in a national network committed to truth and critical education.

training.title: Continuous Training
training.description: We offer workshops, webinars, and educational materials to train multipliers across all regions of Brazil.

openSource.title: Open Source & Open Data
openSource.description: All our work is open and accessible, contributing to a sustainable fact-checking ecosystem.

mission.closingQuote: Together, we can build a more informed and resilient society against misinformation. This is our commitment to education, innovation, and the strengthening of democracy.

benefits.title: Benefits for you and your institution
benefits.description: By joining the National Committee for the Democratization of Fact-Checking, you and your university will have access to exclusive resources and unique collaboration opportunities.

certification.title: Recognized Certification
certification.description: Receive certificates that can be used as complementary hours at your institution.

materials.title: Exclusive Materials
materials.description: Access to templates, practical guides, and educational resources for direct application in the classroom.

research.title: Research Support
research.description: Facilitate studies and projects in partnership with AletheiaFact.org, integrating theory and practice.

support.title: Specialized Support
support.description: Consulting for the implementation of fact-checking centers at your institution.

visibility.title: National Visibility
visibility.description: Public recognition as a partner institution in the fight against misinformation.

reports.title: Impact Reports
reports.description: Documentation of results for accountability and fundraising.

pact.title: Our Collaboration Pact
pact.description: The success of the Committee depends on everyone's active engagement. We share intellectual property results among members to accelerate the democratization of fact-checking, creating an environment of mutual sharing for the advancement of knowledge.

cta.title: Join the National Committee
cta.description: We invite all those who share the commitment to truth, critical education, and the strengthening of democracy.

checklist.item1: Educators from federal and state universities

cta.formDescription: Fill out the form and our team will get in touch with the next steps.
